D.t: Chris Coons leads by 31.3 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 130,725 votes; a one point swing is about 2,090 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +22.4 and D +40.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: New Castle, a projected net 117,357 votes; Kent, a projected net 10,628 votes; Sussex, a projected net 2,675 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Sussex, D +2.3, 28.1% of the vote.
